name: admin_state
desc: The administrative state of IGMP snooping. Some NX-OS versions (e.g. 10.6.4) reject modifying this attribute, in which case it should not be configured. - Choices: `enabled`, `disabled`

name: deletion_policy
desc: What happens on the device when objects managed by the resource are removed. `delete` deletes the object on destroy, including any configuration not managed by Terraform, and deletes single child objects once none of their attributes are configured anymore, unless the device holds other entries below them. `reset` deletes the objects created by the resource on destroy, resets the managed attribut…

name: device
desc: A device name from the provider configuration.

name: domain_control
desc: IGMP snooping domain controls (querier, opt-flood, routing). - Choices: `querier`, `opt-flood`, `routing`

name: global_vlan_disable_nve_static_router_port
desc: Disable NVE static router port for IGMP snooping.

name: global_vlan_vxlan
desc: Enable IGMP snooping on all VXLAN VLANs.

name: global_vlan_vxlan_umc_drop_vlan
desc: Drop unknown multicast traffic on VXLAN VLAN range (e.g. 1-3967).

name: instance_admin_state
desc: The administrative state of the IGMP snooping instance. - Choices: `enabled`, `disabled`

name: instance_control
desc: IGMP snooping instance control flags. - Choices: `stateful-ha`

name: vlans
desc: List of per-VLAN IGMP snooping configurations (`vlan configuration <id>`). - Map key: `vlan_id` - Vlan ID for IGMP Snooping Configuration. Example: `vlan100`.

name: vlans[*].explicit_tracking
desc: Configures Explicit Host for a VLAN.

name: vlans[*].lookup_mac
desc: Indicates if Layer-2 Multicast Lookup Mac is Enabled.

name: vlans[*].max_general_query_miss
desc: Maximum General Query Miss Count. - Range: `3`-`5`

name: vlans[*].mrouter_interfaces
desc: List of static multicast router interfaces (`ip igmp snooping mrouter interface`). - Map key: `interface_id` - Must match first field in the output of `show intf brief`. Example: `eth1/1`.

name: vlans[*].proxy_leave_use_group_address
desc: Use Group IP Address for Proxy-Leave.

name: vlans[*].proxy_max_response_time
desc: Configures MRT for Switch's Proxy General-Queries. - Range: `0`-`25`

name: vlans[*].report_flood_all_interfaces
desc: Enable Report-Flood on all Active Interfaces of VLAN.

name: vlans[*].report_flood_interfaces
desc: List of IGMP snooping interface configurations (`ip igmp snooping report-flood interface`). - Map key: `interface_id` - Must match first field in the output of `show intf brief`. Example: `eth1/1`.

name: vlans[*].report_flood_interfaces[*].report_flood
desc: Indicates if Report Flood is Enabled on the Interface.

name: vlans[*].static_groups
desc: List of static multicast groups (`ip igmp snooping static-group`). - Map key: `group_address` - Multicast Group IP Address.

name: vlans[*].static_groups[*].interfaces
desc: List of static group outgoing interfaces. - Map key: `interface_id` - Must match first field in the output of `show intf brief`. Example: `eth1/1`.

name: vlans[*].static_groups[*].sources
desc: List of static group sources. - Map key: `source_address` - Multicast Source IP Address.

name: vlans[*].static_groups[*].sources[*].interfaces
desc: List of static group source outgoing interfaces. - Map key: `interface_id` - Must match first field in the output of `show intf brief`. Example: `eth1/1`.

name: vlans[*].v3_report_suppression
desc: IGMPv3 Report Suppression and Proxy Reporting.
